### Current project

**Reanalysis of public Illumina data from Chroococcidiopsis-associated samples**

Publicly available sequencing data retrieved from NCBI SRA were used to build and document a complete microbial genomics workflow, from raw-read quality control to taxonomic profiling, assembly and downstream analysis and finally pipeline construction.
